title: Search settings
subtitle: Manage the folders and files included in search.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used by Nookive.

folders.title: Search folders
folders.description: Search the contents of the folders you select.

shortcut.title: Keyboard shortcut
shortcut.description: Open the search window instantly from any app.
shortcut.hint: Click, then press your preferred key combination

models.title: Local models
models.embeddingDescription: Install the local model before building search data or searching.
models.embeddingSize: About 825 MB, downloaded once and kept on this Mac.
models.speechDescription: Optional transcription and word-level timestamps. About 1.9 GB.
models.readyDescription: Models stay on this Mac and are never uploaded with your files.
models.error: The model download failed. Check your connection and try again.

status.title: Search status
status.codeSkippedHint: {{count}} of them are over 1 MB or minified, so they are found by name and path only, not by contents.

accuracy.title: Improve accuracy
accuracy.description: Jump search results to the exact moment when the word was spoken. This may take a little longer to prepare.

reset.title: Reset search data
reset.description: Delete saved search data and rebuild it for the selected folders.
reset.hint: Delete saved search data and build it again

searchHistory.title: Search personalization
searchHistory.description: Results you open are ranked a little higher the next time you search for the same words.
searchHistory.privacyHint: Nookive saves your search words and the opened file paths on this Mac only. They are never sent anywhere.

dataManagement.title: App data
dataManagement.description: Delete downloaded models and search data created by Nookive.
dataManagement.sourceFilesHint: Your selected folders and original files will not be deleted.
dataManagement.confirm: Are you sure you want to delete it?
dataManagement.hint: Deletes models, search results, and app settings.
dataManagement.error: Could not delete app data. Restart the app and try again.

webSearch.title: Web search
webSearch.description: Use your search engine's suggestions and web search when local results are empty and in web search mode (Tab, “web:”).
webSearch.privacyNotice: When web search is enabled, your query may be sent to your search engine ({{engine}}). File contents and local search data are not sent.

weather.title: Weather
weather.description: Type something like “Paris weather” or “weather tomorrow” to see the weather at the top of the results.
weather.privacyNotice: To find the weather, the place name you type is sent to Photon (OpenStreetMap) and the place’s coordinates to Open-Meteo. Your full query, files, and location are not sent.
weather.searchPlaceholder: Search for a city or district
weather.searchError: Couldn’t search for places. Check your internet connection.

worldTime.title: World time
worldTime.description: Type something like “time in New York” or “3pm PST in KST” to see the time somewhere else or convert between time zones.
worldTime.privacyNotice: For questions with a place name, the place name is sent to Photon (OpenStreetMap) and Open-Meteo to find its time zone. Times are calculated on your Mac, and nothing is sent when you only use abbreviations such as KST or PST.

currency.title: Currency conversion
currency.description: Type something like “100 usd in krw” or “€20 to usd” to convert currencies, like the calculator.
currency.privacyNotice: One rate table (based on the US dollar) is downloaded from ExchangeRate-API once a day and stored on your Mac. Your query, amounts, and currencies are not sent.

inlineCompletion.title: App completion
inlineCompletion.description: As you type, the top app's name completes in the search field. Press the Right Arrow key (→) to accept it, or Enter to open the app.

codeSearch.title: Code search
codeSearch.description: Press Tab or type “code:” in the search window to find code files in your search folders by name, path, or contents. The search data stays on this Mac.

loginItem.title: Open at login
loginItem.description: Nookive starts when you log in, so the keyboard shortcut works right away.
loginItem.requiresApproval: Allow Nookive in System Settings to open it at login.
loginItem.failed: Couldn't change the login item. You can change it in System Settings.

dynamic.documentsAndMedia: Search data can be built from {{documents}} documents and {{media}} images, audio, and videos.
dynamic.documents: Search data can be built from {{count}} documents.
dynamic.media: Search data can be built from {{count}} images, audio, and videos.

messages.shortcutFailed: Could not change the shortcut. Choose another key combination.
messages.shortcutModifier: Use one of command, option, control, or shift.
messages.indexFailed: Could not build search data. Please try again later.
messages.autoIndexFailed: Building search data in the background could not finish. Try again from Settings.
messages.storageFull: Building search data stopped because there is not enough storage. Free up space and try again.
messages.asrFailed: Could not load voice search components. Reinstall the app or try again later.
messages.errors: Could not process {{count}} files. Please try again later.
messages.skipped: Skipped {{count}} files. Check their size or format.
messages.resetFailed: Could not reset search data. Restart the app and try again.
messages.indexBusy: Search data is already being built. Try again in a moment.
messages.engineNotReady: The search model is not ready yet. Try again in a moment.

installer.title: Installing Nookive
installer.subtitle: Preparing essential AI components for private, on-device search.
installer.completedSubtitle: Nookive is ready to use on your Mac.
installer.statusReady: All components have been installed successfully.
installer.offlineNotice: Downloaded once and kept securely on this Mac for fast offline search.
installer.shortcutTip: Press your shortcut anytime from any application to open search.
installer.modelLicenseNotice: Models are downloaded from Hugging Face: EmbeddingGemma 2 (Google) and Qwen3-ASR / Qwen3-ForcedAligner (Qwen, Alibaba Cloud), licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
installer.error: An error occurred during installation. Please check your network connection.
installer.setupDescription: Set up your search preferences before using Nookive.
installer.webSearchDescription: Used when local results are empty and in web search mode. Your query may be sent to the search engine (Google by default; you can change it in Settings).
installer.folderDescription: Prepares files in the selected folder so you can find them quickly.
installer.languageDescription: Defaults to your macOS system language.
